---
title: "check-informal-definitions.yml"
---

Flags technical concepts defined in running prose
rather than inside formal Quarto definition divs (`::: {#def-...}`).
In content repositories
(such as Quarto books and sites using theorem-type cross-reference divs),
technical concepts must be formally defined
in dedicated theorem divs (`::: {#def-...}`),
never left in running prose.
Concepts defined only in prose lack stable cross-reference IDs,
cannot be cited downstream,
break hyperlink-on-first-mention requirements,
and escape cross-repository consistency audits.

The check flags:

- **Bold terms followed by defining language.**
  A bolded term followed by "is", "are", "means", "refers to",
  "is defined as", `\eqdef`, or `\triangleq`
  outside a formal `::: {#def-...}` (or sibling theorem) div.
  A bold label that opens a line or list item ("- **Label**: ...")
  and notation (`**X** is denoted $x$`) are not definitions.
- **Mathematical definition operators outside def divs.**
  `\eqdef` or `\triangleq` used in inline or display math outside a def div.
  A local abbreviation (`Let $S_n \eqdef ...$`) is not a definition,
  and a proof or solution div (`::: proof`, `.sol`) is skipped like a theorem div.
- **Prose paragraphs under Definitions headings.**
  Prose paragraphs or bolded terms directly under a heading titled "Definitions"
  that are not wrapped in formal def divs.
- **Naming sentences before display math.**
  Sentences ending in "is:" or "are:"
  immediately preceding display math (`$$...$$`)
  outside a def div,
  when the sentence names a term:
  a bold term, "called", "defined", "known as", "termed", or "we define".
  A leading bold label such as "**Note**:" is not a bold term.
  "The inner derivative is:" computes a value and is not flagged.
- **More than one term in one def div.**
  A `::: {#def-...}` div whose body bolds more than one distinct term
  that is not introduced as an alias ("also called **x**", "or **x**").
  A repeated term, a bare abbreviation, a symbol, a gloss in parentheses
  or quotes, and bold inside a nested div are not counted.
  Nor is a bold label (a term ending in a period, opening a list item,
  or in a table row), or a variant of a counted term
  ("convergent" after "converges").
  One definition per div, so each term gets its own cross-reference ID.

Sections titled "Notation", "Typographic Conventions", or "Symbols" are
recognized as notation guides and exempt from definition requirements.

Individual lines or files can opt out using directive comments:

- Line or block level:
  `<!-- check-informal-definitions: allow -->` or
  `<!-- check-informal-definitions: ignore -->`
- File level: `<!-- check-informal-definitions: ignore-file -->`

## Inputs

| Input              | Type    | Default                                                                                | Description |
| ------------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `path`             | string  | `'.'`                                                                                  | Target directory or file path to scan. |
| `globs`            | string  | `'*.qmd'`                                                                              | Space-separated file globs to check. |
| `paths-ignore`     | string  | `'.git, .github, tests, test, vendor, scratch, _site, node_modules, .venv, venv'`     | Comma- or newline-separated paths or glob patterns to ignore. |
| `fail`             | boolean | `false`                                                                                | Whether to fail the workflow if informal definitions are detected (warn-only by default). |
| `diff-scoped`      | boolean | `false`                                                                                | Report only lines added since base-ref. |
| `base-ref`         | string  | `''`                                                                                   | Git ref/SHA to diff against when diff-scoped is true. |
| `diff`             | string  | `''`                                                                                   | Path to unified diff file to scan added lines from. |
| `output-markdown`  | string  | `''`                                                                                   | Path to write Markdown findings report. |
| `output-json`      | string  | `''`                                                                                   | Path to write structured JSON findings report. |
| `python-version`   | string  | `'3.x'`                                                                                | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-informal-definitions.yml in your repo.
# Flags technical concepts defined in running prose rather than inside formal
# Quarto definition divs (`::: {#def-...}`).
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check informal definitions in prose

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-informal-definitions.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                         # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # block instead of warn (warn-only by default)
    #   diff-scoped: true                      # report only lines a PR adds
    #   runs-on: private-runner                # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See
[`examples/check-informal-definitions.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-informal-definitions.yml)
for the full caller stub.
